complexes: 2 double clean + 1 double military press + 3 double front squat = 1 round. Pick a weight you can press for 1-3 reps; accumulate quality rounds for 15-20 min with generous rest.
Per side: 5 swings, 5 snatches, 5 clean & press, 5 front squats, 1 get-up. Then the other side. 3-5 rounds. The best single test of whether a user owns the fundamentals.
10 x 10 one-hand swings on the 30s, 1 min rest, then 10 x 1 get-ups on the minute. Simple standard: 32kg swings and get-ups for men, 24/16kg for women.
12 minutes of swings plus 5 get-ups per side. The beginner template.
Clean & press ladders (1-2-3, then 1-2-3-4, then 1-2-3-4-5) on press days, alternating with a variety day of swings and snatches.
1 clean + 1 press + 1 front squat one side, switch, repeat continuously for 10-30 min at a conversational pace, light-to-medium load.
clean, front squat, press, reverse lunge, snatch — one side without setting the bell down, then switch. Encode as a no-set-down constraint rather than a fixed list.
500 swings per session x 20 sessions, in sets of 10/15/25/50 with light strength work between. Shocker category.
Snatch VO2max: 15s work / 15s rest, 7 reps per window, scaling toward 80 sets. Pure anaerobic capacity.

coverage_warning.v-pull: GENUINE GAP. Kettlebells cannot provide a true vertical pull — there is no way to load shoulder adduction under load without a bar. kb_floor_pullover is the closest and caps out light because lumbar stability limits it, not lat strength. kb_high_pull and kb_snatch train pulling-under explosively but build no lat hypertrophy. StrongFirst's own forum states this plainly. The app must declare this rather than silently score a kettlebell-only profile as balanced.
coverage_warning.h-push: WEAK. Floor press has a truncated range and a single bell caps the load well below a trained chest. kb_pushup_on_bells partially covers it with bodyweight.
coverage_warning.max lower strength: WEAK. Front squat load is limited by what the rack position can hold, not by leg strength. Progress via leverage (pistol, racked lunge), not load.
coverage_warning.hamstring knee-flexion: ABSENT. Every kettlebell hamstring stimulus is hip extension. No leg-curl equivalent exists.
coverage_warning.strengths: Kettlebells own hinge, carry, anti-lateral-flexion, anti-rotation and the overhead-stability continuum better than almost any other tool. Weight these UP in a kettlebell-only composer — they are where the tool has a real edge.
